item_name: Rothco Healthcare Warrior US Flag T-Shirt - Black
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Caduceus US Flag T-Shirt honors America’s brave healthcare warriors who are working on the front lines during the COVID-19 crisis.
description: Rothco’s Caduceus US Flag T-Shirt honors America’s brave healthcare warriors who are working on the front lines during the COVID-19 crisis. The front of the healthcare warrior shirt features a vertical American flag print with “healthcare” lettering above and “warrior” lettering below. Within the U.S. flag graphic is a black Caduceus symbol, which shows respect and support for healthcare personnel. In addition to the front graphic, the Caduceus shirt’s right sleeve includes a reverse American flag print. Designed with a tagless printed label and a lightweight cotton / polyester construction, the healthcare t-shirt provides a comfortable fit and feel. Proceeds from this purchase help support healthcare workers on the front lines of the COVID-19 crisis.
